question: The compound interest on a sum for 1(1)/(3) years at 12% per annum is Rs. 2496, interest being compounded 8-monthly. What is the amount (in Rs) (to the nearest Rs.) of the same sum for four years at the same rate, when the is compounded yearly?
solution:
**Given:**

The compound interest on a sum for 1(1)/(3) years at 12% per annum is Rs. 2496,

interest being compounded for 8 months.

**Formula used:**

C.I = P × (1 + R/100)ⁿ - P

Amount = P × ( 1 + R/100)ⁿ<
